title: Amazon Store Manager
description:
Amazon FBA Account Manager – UK Store



Experienced Applicants Only | Remote | Long-Term



About the Role

We are an established UK Amazon FBA seller specialising in consumer electronics. We need an experienced Amazon Account Manager to take ownership of the day-to-day store, protect profitability and make sure operational issues do not slip through the cracks.



This is not a beginner VA or product-uploading role. You must already be confident using Amazon Seller Central and managing an FBA account independently.



Main Responsibilities



Manage the Amazon UK store day-to-day, including Seller Central issues, cases and account messages.



Monitor Buy Box performance and manage Revboard while protecting our minimum ROI/profit targets.



Use Sellerboard to monitor sales, COG, fees, refunds, ROI and net profit.



Review ASIN performance and identify profitable fast sellers to reorder, including recommended quantities.



Identify slow-moving, low-ROI or loss-making products and recommend reducing or stopping them.



Monitor inventory, stranded/suppressed listings and FBA stock issues.



Manage FBA shipments and labels when required.



Monitor high-value returns/refunds (£200+) and make sure every unit is accounted for.



Trace returned units through FBA Customer Returns, IDR and Inventory Ledger where required.



Raise and chase eligible Amazon reimbursement claims for missing/lost/damaged inventory.



Arrange or recommend removal of defective/customer-damaged stock where appropriate.



Provide a simple weekly report covering sales, profit, ROI, reorders, poor ASINs, returns, reimbursements and open issues.



Who We Are Looking For



Minimum 3 years of hands-on Amazon FBA / Seller Central experience.



Strong understanding of Buy Box, ROI, margin, COG, Amazon fees and profitability.



Experience investigating FBA returns, lost inventory and reimbursements.



Sellerboard experience strongly preferred.



Revboard experience strongly preferred; other repricer experience is useful.



Keepa and strong Excel/Google Sheets skills are advantageous.



Able to investigate and solve problems independently without constant instructions.



Good written English, organisation and communication.



Please Do Not Apply If

You are new to Amazon, your experience is mainly product uploading/data entry, you have never managed FBA reimbursements, or you need training on normal Seller Central tasks.



How to Apply – Screening Questions

Start your application with: FBA-262



Then answer the questions below. Applications that skip these questions will not be reviewed.



1. How many years have you personally managed Amazon FBA Seller Central accounts, and which marketplaces?



2. What was the approximate monthly revenue of the largest Amazon account you helped manage?



3. What have you used Sellerboard for?



4. Have you used Revboard? If not, which repricers have you managed?



5. How would you d
 whether an ASIN should be reordered? Which metrics would you check?



6. A £350 FBA product was refunded 50 days ago. It has not returned to sellable inventory and no reimbursement is visible. Explain step-by-step how you would investigate it.



7. Give one real example of an FBA reimbursement or inventory issue you personally investigated and resolved.



8. What is your expected monthly salary for a full-time role?



Important: We are looking for someone who can tell us what happened, why it happened, the financial impact, and what action they took — not someone who simply downloads reports. Generic or obviously AI-generated applications that do not demonstrate genuine Amazon experience will not progress.



Monday to Friday - 5ours per day (10am to 3pm) UK time - $4 per hour

title: Short-Form Video Editor (CapCut): Part-Time to Full-Time, Daily Volume
description:
START YOUR APPLICATION WITH THE WORD "CAPCUT". Applications without it won't be read.



ABOUT

I'm a US-based content creator making daily short-form videos (TikTok, Instagram Reels) for tech and AI brands. I'm hiring 2 editors:

- Editor A: stitch-format videos for one main brand

- Editor B: UGC-style videos across several brands



THE WORK

- Edit vertical 9:16 videos from raw footage using templates and a written spec

- Captions, punch-ins, keyframe zooms on screen recordings, speed ramps, sound effects, asset swaps

- Raw footage is in your Google Drive folder by the start of your workday (PH time)

- Finished edits go to your drop folder by 9:00 PM PH time, Mon–Sat

- Every video is checked against a 5-point quality checklist. Only videos that pass on the first try count toward your daily target.



WHO YOU ARE

- Fast and confident in CapCut desktop

- You follow a spec exactly without needing it explained twice

- Consistent on day 30, not just day 1

- You know what makes a hook stop the scroll in the first second

- Reliable internet plus a backup for brownouts (power bank, mobile data, or generator)



PAY & GROWTH PATH

- Paid test: $10 for 3 short videos

- Week 1 trial: $3 per video, 5 videos/day

- Weeks 2–3: part-time, 20 hrs/week, 6–8 videos/day, $250–300/month rate

- Week 4+: full-time, 40 hrs/week, 12–15 videos/day, $450–600/month



Moving to full-time is based on clear criteria: 2 straight weeks with no more than 1 revision per 5 videos and zero missed deadlines. Paid weekly via Wise or PayPal.



You'll sign a simple confidentiality agreement, since you'll see unreleased brand content.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your message with CAPCUT

2. Links to 2–3 short-form videos you edited (TikTok, Reels, or Drive links)

3. Your usual turnaround time for a 30-second edit

4. Which role fits you better: A (stitch) or B (UGC, multi-brand)

5. Any other clients or jobs you currently have, and how many hours they take



20/week to start, 40/week within 30 days



Top candidates get the paid test within 48 hours.

title: Senior Full-Stack BigCommerce B2B Developer & E-Commerce Specialist
description:
World Class Industrial Supply is a growing U.S.-based industrial distributor serving wind-energy, electrical, construction, maintenance and industrial-service customers nationwide.



We sell industrial tools, torque and hydraulic equipment, safety products, high-voltage equipment, workwear, rigging products and specialty supplies. We also provide calibration, repair and equipment-rental services.



Our e-commerce platform uses BigCommerce B2B Edition integrated with NetSuite through Folio3.



Position Overview



We are seeking a Senior Full-Stack BigCommerce B2B Developer & E-Commerce Specialist based in the Philippines.



This is a hybrid technical and operational position. The successful candidate will develop, maintain and improve our BigCommerce storefront while also helping manage the daily functionality of our B2B e-commerce environment.



Candidates must have experience supporting B2B websites with customer hierarchies, including parent companies, locations, company administrators, buyers, purchasing permissions and approval workflows.



This is not a basic product-upload, virtual-assistant or Shopify-only position. The successful candidate must be comfortable working with BigCommerce theme code, APIs, custom applications, integrations and B2B functionality.



This is a long-term employment opportunity structured as an independent-contractor arrangement. The successful candidate will be treated as a valued member of our company and included in relevant team communications, planning and decision-making. This person will work directly with the company’s owners, have meaningful responsibility for our e-commerce platform and play an important role in the company’s long-term growth.



Primary Development Responsibilities



Customize and maintain our BigCommerce Stencil theme

Develop and improve front-end and back-end e-commerce functionality

Work with HTML5, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript, TypeScript and Handlebars templates

Develop and maintain server-side services, middleware and custom integrations

Create reusable Page Builder widgets and website components

Work with BigCommerce REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks and third-party applications

Work with databases, authentication, data mapping and error-handling processes

Troubleshoot cart, checkout, account-registration, payment, tax and shipping issues

Improve desktop and mobile responsiveness

Improve website speed, accessibility and technical SEO

Develop and enhance Request a Quote functionality

Maintain code using Git and GitHub

Test changes in a copied theme, sandbox or development environment before deploying to production

Document code, system configurations, deployments and troubleshooting procedures

Troubleshoot the BigCommerce side of our Folio3–NetSuite integration

Coordinate with NetSuite, Folio3 and other integration partners when ERP-side work is required

Monitor integrations, investigate failed transactions and help prevent recurring errors



B2B E-Commerce Responsibilities



Manage B2B company accounts and customer hierarchies

Configure parent companies, locations, company administrators, buyers and other purchasing roles

Establish and maintain user permissions, spending limits and approval workflows

Manage customer-specific catalogs, price lists, discounts and product visibility

title: Business Development Executive | B2B Sales | U.S. Company
description:
American Sign & Lighting is looking for an experienced Business Development Executive to help us find, develop, and win new customers in the U.S. market.



We're looking for a hunter.



Someone who is comfortable researching potential customers, picking up the phone, reaching decision-makers, starting Sales conversations, following up consistently, and turning prospects into real business opportunities.



This is not a Customer Service position, and it is not a role where you will simply wait for leads to be assigned to you.



Your job is to help create new business.



What You'll Do

Research and identify potential B2B customers.

Prospect new accounts through outbound calling and other outreach methods.

Connect with business owners, managers, and decision-makers.

Introduce our services and uncover potential business needs.

Qualify prospects and develop new Sales opportunities.

Schedule and conduct follow-up conversations.

Build relationships with prospects over time.

Maintain an active and organized Sales pipeline.

Track leads, conversations, follow-ups, and opportunities in the CRM.

Help move opportunities through the Sales process toward closing.

Re-engage prospects who have gone cold.

Consistently look for new ways to generate business.



What We're Looking For:

You should have previous experience in one or more of the following:

Business Development | B2B Sales | Outbound Sales | Account Executive | Sales Development | Lead Generation



We're especially interested in candidates who can demonstrate:

Strong outbound prospecting experience.

Confidence making Sales calls.

Experience selling to U.S. customers or businesses.

Ability to speak professionally with decision-makers.

Experience generating your own leads or identifying target accounts.

Strong follow-up and pipeline management.

CRM experience.

Measurable Sales results.

Excellent spoken and written English.

Persistence, organization, and self-motivation.



Closing experience is a strong advantage.





This Is More Than Cold Calling.

Yes, outbound calling is an important part of the job. But we're not looking for someone whose only goal is to hit a call number.

We want someone who understands the bigger picture:

Find the right prospect → Start the conversation → Identify the opportunity → Follow up → Build the relationship → Move the opportunity forward → Win business.



If you've spent your career generating appointments but have never been responsible for what happens afterward, this may not be the right opportunity.



Who Will Succeed Here?

Someone who doesn't need to ask: "Who should I call next?"



Instead, you think: "Where can I find the next customer?"

You're resourceful, persistent, comfortable with rejection, and motivated by creating opportunities and producing results.



Compensation:

$1,000–$2,000 USD per month, commensurate with experience.



We are willing to invest in experienced Sales talent who can demonstrate the ability to generate meaningful business opportunities and contribute to revenue growth.

title: UK B2C Outbound Sales & Qualification Specialist | Full-Time | Great Commission
description:
UK B2C Outbound Sales & Qualification Specialist | Full-Time | Great Commission



Build your career with a fast-growing UK brand—not just another VA job.



Are you confident on the phone, naturally good with people and motivated by achieving great results?



Do you want to work with a company that values your contribution, supports your development and gives you the opportunity to grow into a long-term career?



Care Claim Line is a growing UK customer support business helping older people and their families understand and access support they may be entitled to.



We are now expanding our operations and building our Philippines-based FRT team. We are looking for ambitious, professional and customer-focused Filipino team members who want to be part of something bigger than a standard freelance role.



This is your opportunity to work directly with a growing UK company, join a supportive international team and help build the customer experience as our business continues to expand.



This is not a general Virtual Assistant position.



This is a professional, phone-based B2C customer qualification role for someone who enjoys meaningful conversations, takes pride in helping customers, loves working towards targets and wants to be rewarded for strong performance.



Most importantly, this is not a cold-calling role.



Every customer you contact has already opted in, made an enquiry or requested that Care Claim Line contact them. You will be speaking with people who are expecting to hear from us and have already shown an interest in finding out more.



WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING



You’ll speak with UK customers who have made an enquiry with us or specifically asked to be contacted, then guide them through our initial qualification process.



Your role will include:



• Making outbound calls to UK customers who have opted in or requested contact

• Speaking confidently, warmly and professionally with older customers

• Creating a positive first impression of Care Claim Line

• Following our structured qualification process

• Asking thoughtful questions and listening carefully to each customer

• Understanding the customer’s situation and identifying whether they may be suitable for our service

• Completing customer information accurately in our system

• Passing qualified customers to our UK sales team

• Following up with customers when required

• Working towards clear daily and weekly KPIs

• Contributing ideas and feedback as our Philippines operation develops



You will never be expected to cold-call random or purchased lists.



The people you contact will already have engaged with Care Claim Line and asked to hear from us. Your role is to respond promptly, build trust, understand their needs and help them take the next step.



You are not responsible for completing the full customer application.



Your job is to make the customer feel listened to, qualify them accurately and create a high-quality handover to our UK team.



WHY JOIN CARE CLAIM LINE?



This is more than a remote calling job.



You’ll be joining a growing UK company at an exciting stage of its development. We are building our Philippines team from the ground up, which means the people who join us early will have the opportunity to make a real impact and grow alongside the business.



You’ll work with a team that values energy, professionalism, accountability and a great customer experience.



We want our team members to feel proud of the work they do, supported by the people around them and excited about where the company is going.



As we expand, high-performing team members will have the opportunity to take on more responsibility, support new starters, help improve processes and progress into senior, training and team leadership positions.



If you are ambitious, reliable and ready to build something with us, this could be the beginning of a long-term opportunity—not just another online job.



WHO WE WANT



We’re particularly interested in candidates with experience in:



UK B2C outbound sales

UK call centres / BPO

Lead qualification

Appointment setting

Telesales

Customer service

Inbound enquiries and warm outbound follow-up

CRM systems and diallers



Previous experience speaking with UK customers is highly desirable.



Experience handling warm leads, opted-in enquiries or callback requests is especially valuable.



Please note that this is fundamentally different from cold calling. Customers have already expressed interest and are expecting contact from the business.



We’re looking for someone who is:



Confident and engaging on the telephone

Warm, friendly and naturally personable

Excellent at spoken English

Easy for UK customers to understand

Patient and respectful when speaking with older customers

A strong listener who can ask the right questions

Competitive and motivated by targets

Reliable, punctual and professionally presented

Comfortable following structured processes

Accurate when recording customer information

Open to feedback and committed to improving

Motivated by commission, progression and long-term growth



WORKING HOURS



This is a full-time position working UK business hours, so please make sure you are comfortable working the corresponding Philippines hours before applying.



You’ll work remotely from the Philippines as part of our wider UK customer team.



We value professionalism, consistency and communication, while also understanding the benefits of working remotely. You’ll have the flexibility of a home-based role while being part of a structured, supportive and ambitious international team.



WHAT WE PROVIDE



You’ll receive:



• Full training and ongoing support

• A clear and structured call process

• Professional cloud phone and customer management systems

• Existing opted-in customer enquiries and callback requests to contact

• UK management and support

• Regular feedback and coaching

• Clear performance targets

• Base pay plus performance-related earning opportunities

• The opportunity to work directly with a growing UK company

• A supportive team culture built around professionalism and development

• Opportunities to progress as our Philippines operation grows

• The chance to help shape and build our FRT team from the beginning



We’re not looking to build a team of temporary freelancers.



We’re looking for people who want to grow with the company.



As the Philippines operation expands, there will be opportunities for high performers to progress into senior, training and team leadership positions.



The people who join us early will have the chance to help shape how the team works, support future colleagues and become an important part of Care Claim Line’s growth story.



IMPORTANT – VOICE SAMPLE REQUIRED



The quality of your spoken English is extremely important for this position.



When applying, please send us:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your outbound/BPO experience.

2. Details of any experience working with UK customers.

3. Details of your experience handling warm leads, opted-in enquiries or customer callback requests.

4. Your previous sales or qualification KPIs, if you know them.

5. A 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you think you would be a strong fit for Care Claim Line.

6. Your expected hourly or monthly base salary.



Applications without a voice recording may not be considered.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an online interview and a short mock customer call based on a warm customer enquiry.



We’re recruiting a small initial team now, with plans to expand significantly based on performance.



If you’re confident on the phone, naturally good with people, motivated by results and excited by the opportunity to help build a growing UK company’s Philippines operation, we’d love to hear from you.



Join us early. Grow with us. Help shape what comes next.

title: Finance & Bookkeeping Assistant — Agency & Personal Finances (Part-Time, Remote)
description:
I run a UK-based creative agency working with e-commerce brands spending millions per month on ads. I need a detail-oriented finance assistant to manage both my business finances and personal finances. You'll be the person who keeps track of every dollar coming in and going out, makes sure payments are processed on time, and gives me clear visibility on my financial position at all times.



This role is part bookkeeper, part financial analyst, part personal finance manager. If you love spreadsheets, cashflow forecasting, and making sense of messy numbers — this is for you.



What You'll Do:



Business Finance:



Track all agency income across multiple clients — retainers, percentage of spend invoices, and any other revenue

Track all business expenses — editor payments, strategist payments, software subscriptions, tools, and operational costs

Calculate monthly profit and loss per client and for the agency overall

Process payments to editors, strategists, and contractors via Revolut Business (you will be added as a Team Member)

Send client invoices via Revolut Business and track payment status

Chase outstanding invoices and flag overdue payments

Calculate monthly editor payroll based on output data provided by the operations team

Maintain a clean, up-to-date financial dashboard in Google Sheets showing revenue, expenses, profit, and cash position



Personal Finance:



Track all personal income and spending across bank accounts and credit cards

Categorise every personal transaction weekly — food, dining, travel, rent, subscriptions, entertainment, transport, clothing, health, etc.

Create visual spending breakdowns — pie charts or bar charts showing where money is going each month

Flag areas where spending is too high and recommend where to cut back

Track personal net worth monthly — bank balances, investments, assets, debts

Help set and monitor monthly personal budgets



Cashflow & Forecasting:



Maintain a rolling cashflow forecast — what's coming in over the next 30, 60, 90 days based on client contracts and expected payments

Flag any upcoming cash crunches before they happen — e.g. if a big invoice hasn't been paid and payroll is due

Forecast monthly income based on current client retainers and projected ad spend percentages

Track progress towards financial targets and goals — I'll share my targets and you tell me if I'm on pace or falling behind

Model scenarios — e.g. "if I sign 2 more clients at $10K, what does my monthly P&L look like after team costs?"



Reporting:



Send a weekly financial summary every Monday — total income, total expenses, net position, outstanding invoices, upcoming payments due

Send a monthly financial report — full P&L, spending breakdown, personal vs business analysis, progress towards targets, cashflow forecast update

All reports should be visual and easy to read — charts, colour coding, clear summaries. Not walls of numbers



Requirements:



Degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration

Strong Google Sheets or Excel skills — formulas, charts, pivot tables, conditional formatting, dashboards

Experience with bookkeeping, financial tracking, or management accounting

Excellent attention to detail — every number must be accurate, every transaction categorised correctly

Reliable and consistent — the weekly report must arrive every Monday without being chased

Good written English for clear communication

Comfortable handling sensitive financial information with complete confidentiality

Proactive — if you see a problem in the numbers, flag it immediately, don't wait for me to ask

Comfortable learning new tools — you will be using Revolut Business to process payments and send invoices



Strong Preference For:



Experience working with agencies, freelancers, or small businesses managing multiple income streams

Experience with Revolut Business, Stripe, Xero, or QuickBooks

Experience with cashflow forecasting and financial modelling

Experience managing multi-currency finances (USD, GBP, EUR)

Ability to create clean, visual financial dashboards and reports



Working Hours:



Flexible, but must be available for a weekly 15-minute check-in call during UK business hours (9am-5pm GMT/BST). Weekly report due every Monday by 12pm UK time. Monthly report due by the 3rd of each month.



How to Apply:



Please reply with:



A short intro — who you are, your background in finance or accounting, and why this role is a good fit for you

Your highest qualification in accounting or finance

Describe your experience tracking finances for a business or individual — what tools did you use and what did you report on?

A link to or screenshot of any financial spreadsheet, dashboard, budget tracker, or P&L you have created (can be anonymised)

title: Marketing Operations VA (Meta Ads + GoHighLevel)
description:

- Fluent English, spoken and written. You are on a video call with us every working day. We test this in the interview.

- Meta Business Suite and Ads Manager. You can read the metrics and spot a ban or a rejected ad without being told.

PAY

HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your message with the word PIXEL. We do not read applications without it.

2. Send a Loom link, 2 to 3 minutes, unscripted. Introduce yourself (camera on), then share your screen and walk us through any ads manager, CRM or reporting dashboard you have used. We want to hear you talk and watch you use a real tool.

3. Answer the 4 questions at the end of the job description document.

title: Onboarding & Claims Support Specialist
description:
We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive Onboarding & Claims Support Specialist to oversee the client onboarding process from the moment a new client is handed off through the completion of onboarding.



This role focuses heavily on client onboarding, documentation, case tracking, follow-up, and VA claims support. The ideal candidate will have a background as a paralegal, legal secretary, legal assistant, or in a similar documentation-heavy role.



This is primarily a behind-the-scenes position. Client communication will be handled mainly through text messaging,
, CRM systems, and other internal platforms, with the goal of keeping clients moving through the process without unnecessary phone calls.



The ideal candidate is someone who takes ownership, stays ahead of missing documentation, keeps accurate records, and can manage multiple clients and deadlines without constant supervision.



Primary ResponsibilitiesClient Onboarding

Oversee the complete onboarding process for new clients from handoff through completion.

Review each client's onboarding progress and ensure required steps are completed.

Track required documentation and identify missing or incomplete items.

Proactively follow up with clients through text when documents or information are missing.

Help clients understand what documents are needed and how to submit them.

Use available step-by-step video guides and written instructions to help clients complete onboarding.

Monitor client progress and identify clients who may be falling behind.

Escalate issues or situations that require additional assistance.



Onboarding Tracking & Reporting

Maintain and update the onboarding document tracker.

Maintain accurate information in the daily onboarding report.

Keep the team updated on new clients and their onboarding status.

Track important milestones, outstanding documents, and client communication.

Identify bottlenecks or delays and proactively address them.

Ensure onboarding records remain accurate, organized, and up to date.



Documentation & Case Support

Collect, review, and organize client documentation.

Review files for completeness and identify missing information.

Maintain organized digital case files and documentation.

Ensure documents are properly named, stored, and uploaded to the appropriate secure folders.

Maintain strict confidentiality when handling client information and sensitive records.



VA Claims Support

Once a client's Medical Evidence Summary is completed:

Review the Medical Evidence Summary and identify the primary target conditions.

Review the recommended next steps and supporting documentation.

Draft the necessary VA forms based on the identified target conditions.

Ensure forms are complete and accurately reflect the information provided.

Upload completed forms to the secure folder for future review, editing, and use.

Flag questions, missing information, or potential issues for the appropriate team member.

title: U.S. Bookkeeping & Accounting Professional
description:
Immediate Opening



We are looking for a full-time accounting professional in the Philippines who wants to build a long-term career working with U.S.-based clients.



This position is a little different from a typical bookkeeping role, so please read the entire description before applying.



What the Role Looks Like



For the first 1 to 3 months, a significant part of this position will involve high-volume data entry for one U.S. client.



This client processes a large number of transactions, potentially 50 to 100+ invoices per day, across both accounts payable and accounts receivable. You need to be comfortable working accurately and efficiently with this level of volume.



We want to be very clear about this upfront. If you dislike repetitive, high-volume transaction entry, this probably isn't the right position for you.



However, the position will not stay this way.



We are actively working to automate much of this process. Sales and AR activity will eventually flow from ServiceTitan into the accounting system, and AP invoices will increasingly be processed using OCR and automation tools.



As those systems are implemented, your role will shift from primarily entering transactions to reviewing transactions, monitoring automated processes, bookkeeping, reconciliations, and working with additional U.S. clients.



Our expectation is that this position will eventually support approximately 3 to 5 U.S. clients, starting with our less complicated accounts. As your skills and knowledge grow, there will be opportunities to take on more complex accounting responsibilities.



What We're Looking For



We would especially like to hear from candidates who have:



* Experience working directly with U.S.-based clients, preferably multiple clients

* Strong experience with QuickBooks Online

* Experience with bookkeeping, bank reconciliations, AP and AR

* Experience processing a high volume of invoices or other financial transactions

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy

* The ability to work efficiently with repetitive tasks without sacrificing quality

* Good written and verbal English communication skills

* A reliable, high-speed internet connection and dependable home work environment

* An interest in learning new accounting systems and technology

* A genuine interest in working with and eventually supporting multiple U.S. businesses



Experience with ServiceTitan would be a major plus, but it is not required.



Work Schedule



This is a full-time, 8-hour-per-day position working U.S. hours.



Your regular workday will end at 2:00 AM Pacific Time, so please make sure you are comfortable working this schedule on a long-term basis before applying.



We strongly prefer candidates who have previously worked a night or graveyard schedule for U.S. clients and already know that this schedule works for them.



Where This Position Can Go



We're not looking for someone just to enter invoices.



We're looking for someone who can handle the high-volume work required at the beginning, learn our clients and systems, and then grow into a broader accounting and bookkeeping role.



As we automate the repetitive work, we want to give you more responsibility and expose you to additional U.S. clients. For someone who wants to develop their U.S. accounting experience, there is significant room to grow.



How to Apply



Please submit both of the following:



1. Your resume

2. A short video introduction, approximately 1 minute



In your video, please briefly tell us:



* Your accounting/bookkeeping background

* How much experience you have working with U.S. clients

* The highest volume of invoices or transactions you've handled

* Whether you've previously worked a U.S. night/graveyard schedule

* Why you're interested in working with more U.S.-based clients



Applications without both a resume and video will not be considered.

[rate / salary] — [hours per week]

We are looking for someone with prior experience supporting a **U.S. plaintiff-side personal injury law firm** who is organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and interested in a long-term working relationship.



This is **not an entry-level virtual assistant position**. The ideal candidate should already understand the general life cycle of a personal injury case and be able to assist with both pre-litigation and litigation support with minimal day-to-day instruction.



### Responsibilities

* Assist with preparation of settlement demand packages

* Assist attorneys with discovery preparation and litigation file organization

* Help organize responses to interrogatories and requests for production

* Coordinate depositions, mediations, medical appointments, and other case-related scheduling

* Maintain task lists and follow up on outstanding items

* Keep case management records accurate and current

* Identify missing information and alert the supervising attorney to unresolved issues or approaching deadlines

* Assist with routine client follow-up and case status communications

* Make sure files remain organized and cases continue moving forward



### Required Qualifications



* At least **2–3 years of personal injury experience**

* Prior experience working for a **U.S. plaintiff-side personal injury law firm strongly preferred**

* Familiarity with U.S. personal injury terminology and workflow

* Experience handling medical records, medical bills, treatment tracking, and settlement demand packages

* Experience supporting personal injury cases after a lawsuit has been filed is highly preferred

* Strong written and spoken English

* Excellent organizational and follow-up skills

* Ability to communicate professionally with U.S. clients by telephone and

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to maintain strict confidentiality

### Hours



This position will initially be **part-time, approximately 20 hours per week**.



There is an opportunity to increase hours based on the candidate’s experience, performance, reliability, and the needs of the firm’s personal injury practice.



A strong candidate who demonstrates the ability to independently manage assigned responsibilities, consistently follow up on outstanding matters, communicate professionally with clients, and keep files organized and moving forward may have the opportunity to increase to **30–40 hours per week**.

WFP SALES TEAM

If World Famous Puppies is advertising Golden Retrievers today, you should already have several strong Golden Retriever options organized and ready before customers begin asking for them.



If a customer is sent puppy GR-104, our sales team must be able to immediately find:



GR-104 → breed → gender → photographs → cost → breeder/seller → source website → direct listing link → seller contact → location → availability → delivery information



There should be no confusion and no searching from scratch after the customer chooses the puppy.



Breeds You Should Understand



You should already be familiar with popular breeds including:



Golden Retrievers, Pomeranians, Shih Tzus, Yorkshire Terriers, Maltese, Poodles, Mini Poodles, Goldendoodles, Cavapoos, Dachshunds, French Bulldogs and other popular companion breeds.

Extremely organized

Excellent at data entry

Detail-oriented

Able to follow systems exactly

Reliable and consistent

, websites, WhatsApp and online marketplaces

Dog Knowledge Is Required

Pet businesses, breeders, kennels, pet stores, veterinary businesses, animal rescue, puppy sales, pet e-commerce or dog ownership.



You must genuinely understand dogs.



If you cannot quickly identify common dog breeds or have no interest in the pet industry, this position is probably not appropriate for you.



Accuracy Is Critical



One mistake can cost the company a customer.



You must never confuse:



One puppy with another

One breeder with another

Male versus female

Puppy cost

Location

Customer

Source link

Availability status



We expect accurate records at all times.



Inventory System



You will maintain a master inventory sheet containing information such as:



Puppy ID | Breed | Gender | Color | DOB/Age | Photos | Source Website | Listing URL | Breeder/Seller | Seller Contact | Cost | Selling Price | Location | Availability | Last Checked | Delivery Information | Customer Assigned | Notes



We will train you on the exact World Famous Puppies system.



What We Are Looking For



We want somebody who thinks ahead.



If our advertising team tells you tomorrow's campaign is focused on Pomeranians and Golden Retrievers, we should not have to wait until customers arrive to start looking for puppies.



You should already be preparing the inventory.



The goal is:



Customer asks → puppy options are already ready → customer selects one → availability is verified → closer closes → puppy is purchased.



Speed is extremely important.



Compensation



I would start this position at:



$4.50–$5.50 USD per hour



At 40 hours per week, that's roughly $780–$950 USD per month, depending on experience and the exact schedule.



For an exceptional candidate with significant pet-industry or puppy-sourcing experience, you can pay more.



I would use a 30-day paid probation period, then review performance and compensation.



Performance Will Be Measured



We will monitor:



Accuracy of inventory

Number of usable puppies sourced

Speed of sourcing

Availability accuracy

Number of expired listings removed

Response time when sales asks for a puppy

Quality of puppy options

Accuracy of breeder/source information

Organization of photographs and records

Communication with the sales team



This is a results-oriented position.



How to Apply



Contact World Famous Puppies directly:



WhatsApp / Phone: 
Start your message with:



WFP SOURCING TEAM



Please include:

Also send a 30–60 second English voice introduction explaining why you would be a good fit.



We are interviewing immediately and want to hire the right person as soon as possible.

Don't hire this person without testing them.



Give the applicant 20 minutes and tell them:



Find me 5 female Golden Retrievers, 5 Pomeranians and 3 Shih Tzus that appear currently available. Put them into a Google Sheet with puppy name/ID, sex, color, price, location, source URL and seller information. Organize the puppy photos so I can immediately tell which photos belong to which listing.



That test will tell you almost everything.



You don't need the candidate who's best at interviewing. You need the person who comes back fast, organized, accurate, and with zero mixed-up puppies.



Then your initial World Famous Puppies team is very lean:



1 Puppy Sourcing Coordinator → 2 Inbound Lead Reps → Gabriel + 2 Closers → purchase/delivery operations.



That's enough people to get the machine moving without burning your $5,000 operating cash on unnecessary payroll.

title: Appointment Setter / Sales VA
description:

Warm Leads + Patient Reactivation | US Medical Spa



About Us

We are an established, growing medical aesthetics and wellness practice in California offering advanced aesthetic treatments including lasers, CO2 resurfacing, radiofrequency skin tightening, body contouring, injectables, Hydrafacials, and other cosmetic treatments. We are looking for a Philippines-based Appointment Setter / Sales VA who is confident on the phone and experienced with medical aesthetics. This is a sales-focused position, not primarily an administrative VA role.



Role Overview

We’re hiring a Philippines-based Appointment Setter to handle:

- Calling/texting inbound aesthetic leads from paid ads and other marketing sources

- Following up with warm leads who have inquired but have not booked

- Re-engaging older leads and previous patients

- Calling patients who may be due for additional or maintenance treatments

- Following our provided scripts and sales process

- Asking questions to understand the patient's aesthetic goals and interests

- Handling basic objections regarding price, timing, treatments, downtime, etc.

- Booking consultations and treatment appointments

- Updating all activity, notes, and follow-up inside GoHighLevel (GHL) and/or Zenoti

- Maintaining an organized sales pipeline



Treatments you may be discussing include:

- CO2 laser resurfacing

- Fractional laser treatments

- Radiofrequency skin tightening

- Body sculpting / body contouring

- Botox / Dysport and other neuromodulators

- Dermal fillers

- Biostimulators

- Microneedling

- IPL / photofacial treatments

- Laser hair removal

- Hydrafacials

- Other medical aesthetic treatments



You will not provide medical advice. Clinical questions will be directed to our licensed medical providers.



What You’ll Do Daily

- Make outbound calls to warm leads, previous inquiries, and existing patients

- Contact new leads quickly after they inquire

- Follow up consistently with leads who have not yet booked

- Re-engage leads who previously expressed interest but stopped responding

- Follow our sales script while still sounding conversational and natural

- Ask questions to determine patient goals, concerns, treatment interests, and readiness to schedule

- Overcome basic objections and keep the conversation moving toward an appointment

- Book qualified prospects directly onto our schedule

- Log call outcomes, notes, tags, and follow-up tasks

- Maintain clean pipeline stages and accurate CRM records

- Follow up by call and text when appropriate

- Track appointments booked, completed appointments, and other sales KPIs



Requirements — Non-Negotiable

- Based in the Philippines

- 2+ years of phone sales, appointment setting, or outbound calling experience

- Excellent spoken English with a clear/neutral accent

- Warm, confident, professional, and personable phone presence

- Comfortable making outbound calls throughout the workday

- Experience with a dialer or internet-based calling system

- Experience working inside a CRM

- GoHighLevel (GHL) experience strongly preferred

- Zenoti experience highly preferred

- Comfortable following a script while still having a natural conversation

- Strong objection-handling skills

- Comfortable asking directly for the appointment

- Comfortable being measured on performance metrics such as calls, connects, appointments booked, show rates, and conversions

- Reliable computer + professional headset

- Strong, reliable internet connection

- Quiet, professional work environment

- Ability to work during US Pacific Time business hours



Nice-to-Haves

- Previous work with US clients

- Appointment setting or sales experience for a medical spa, aesthetics clinic, plastic surgery practice, dermatology practice, or cosmetic clinic

- Experience selling or booking higher-ticket services

- Experience with paid-ad leads

- Experience reactivating old leads or patient databases

- Knowledge of aesthetic treatments and terminology

- Experience with both GoHighLevel and Zenoti

- Strong history of meeting or exceeding appointment-setting KPIs



Compensation

- $6–$8 USD/hour based on experience + performance bonuses

Performance bonuses may be based on metrics such as:

- Qualified appointments booked

- Completed consultations

- Show rate

- Patient conversions

- Sales/revenue generated



We are looking for someone who is motivated by results and wants the opportunity to earn more based on performance.



How to Apply

Please submit the following:

1. Resume



2. Voice Recording — REQUIRED

Please send a 60–90 second audio recording introducing yourself.

In your recording, please tell us:

- Your name and professional background

- Your phone sales / appointment-setting experience

- Your experience working with US businesses or clients

- Any experience working specifically with medical spas, aesthetics, cosmetic medicine, plastic surgery, or dermatology

- Your knowledge and experience discussing medical aesthetic treatments including:

- CO2 laser resurfacing

- Radiofrequency skin tightening

- Body sculpting / body contouring

- Botox / Dysport

- Dermal fillers

* The harder cases the AI escalates to you: disputes, refunds, anything needing judgment.

* The patterns. Spot recurring friction early and bring the fix, not just the complaint.

Not for You If



* You see this as "just a job."

* You need step-by-step direction and go quiet when something's off.

* You hand over problems instead of solving them.

* You measure yourself by ticket count instead of whether the customer's actual problem got solved.

1. Answer our application questions properly.

* Health insurance (HMO)

* An annual training and learning budget

We genuinely take care of our team and invest heavily in our people. We want someone who takes ownership, grows with us, and builds something meaningful for the long term.

title: Lead Researcher / List Builder – Amazon Seller Leads (Verified Emails, No Duplicates)
description:
We are a Dubai-based e-commerce consultancy working with Amazon brands and sellers in Germany, the UK and the US. We need someone who builds clean, verified lead lists of Amazon sellers for our outbound campaigns.



This is detail work. We do not need volume. We need lists we can load into our sending tool without cleaning them first.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Research Amazon third-party sellers and brands and deliver them in a Google Sheet with these exact columns:



First Name

Last Name

Job Title


LinkedIn URL

Company Name

Amazon Seller Page (storefront or brand page URL)

Company Country

Seller Type (Private Label / Brand Owner / Reseller / Aggregator / Agency)

Company Website

Employees

Company LinkedIn URL

Monthly Revenue (estimate)

Review Rating



QUALITY RULES (this is what the job is really about)



1. Right person, not just any person. We need the decision maker: Founder, Owner, CEO, Managing Director, Head of E-Commerce, Amazon Manager, Marketplace Manager. Not interns, not warehouse staff, not accountants. If a company has no reachable decision maker, skip it.



2. Verified
s only. Every personal
 must be run through a verification tool (NeverBounce, MillionVerifier, ZeroBounce or similar) and marked as valid. "Accept-all" or "risky" results are not acceptable and must be excluded, not included with a note. Our bounce rate must stay under 2 percent.



3. Zero duplicates. No duplicate
s, no duplicate companies, no duplicate domains across the whole list AND against the master list we give you. You dedupe before you deliver, not us.



4. Amazon Seller Page is mandatory. If you cannot find the actual Amazon storefront or brand page of the company, the lead does not go on the list. This is our most important filter. A company that "probably sells on Amazon" is not a lead.



5. Revenue estimate must come from a source. Use Helium 10, Jungle Scout, SellerAmp, Keepa, Similarweb or public company data. Write the source in a notes column. Never guess.



6. Data must be clean. Correct spelling and capitalisation of first names (we use them in
 personalisation, so "MARIA" or "maria" or "M. Schmidt" is a fail), no trailing spaces, consistent country names, working URLs.



TOOLS

You should be comfortable with at least some of: 
, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, 
, 
, Clay, Helium 10 / Jungle Scout / Keepa, Google Sheets. Tell us which ones you have access to and which ones we would need to provide.



WHO THIS IS FOR

You are a good fit if you are patient, precise, and you would rather deliver 100 perfect leads than 500 messy ones. You check your own work before you send it. You ask questions when a rule is unclear instead of guessing.



You are not a good fit if you plan to scrape a database, export it and send it over unverified. We check every list we receive.



HOURS AND START

Start part time, around 20 hours per week, with a fixed weekly delivery target we agree together. If the quality is right, this becomes a long-term full-time role with a raise. We pay on time, every time.



HOW TO APPLY

Please do not send a generic application. Answer these in your message:



1. Put the word AMAZON-LIST in the first line of your application, so we know you read this.

2. Which tools do you currently have paid access to?

3. How do you verify an
 before putting it on a list? Name the tool and the exact steps.

4. How would you find the Amazon storefront of a brand when the brand does not link to it from their website?

Applications without the sample will not be reviewed.

title: Senior Local SEO Lead - UK Trades & Home Services
description:
Local Launchpad helps UK local service businesses; landscapers, roofers, electricians, plumbers, cleaners and similar trades, dominate Google through high-converting websites, SEO and Google Business Profile optimisation.



We launched in June, already have paying clients, and are building this to scale toward hundreds.



Everything runs on systems. We have our own AI copy system that generates website copy, meta titles and descriptions, schema and GBP content for every client, with content pushed directly into WordPress. Sites can go live in days, not weeks. At least that is the aim, we are not quite there just yet.



We're now looking for someone to own SEO across the entire business. Not a task-doer. Not someone waiting for an SEO checklist.



We want the person who d
 what good looks like, builds the methodology behind it, and makes sure every website and GBP we ship is technically and strategically right from the ground up.



Feel free to take a look at our landing page to get a better understanding of Local Launchpad: 
  





—-





YOUR FIRST JOB: TELL US WHAT WE'RE GETTING WRONG



We already run a documented SEO methodology — H1 formulas, page architecture rules, mandatory on-page signals, GBP category handling. It works well enough to get clients ranking. But it was largely inherited and has never been stress-tested by someone who genuinely knows their stuff.



Your first task is to audit it honestly and tell us what's right, what's outdated, and what's actively costing our clients rankings. We'd rather hear it now than in six months.





—-





WHAT YOU'LL OWN



Site architecture and keyword strategy

Keyword research, search-intent analysis, competitor and SERP research, keyword-to-page mapping, URL structure and internal linking. D
 how homepage, service, category, location and service × location pages should be structured and targeted and what copy belongs to each page, where, how long it should be and what it needs to say — and critically, d
 which pages shouldn't exist at all. We don't want to create hundreds of pages just because we can. You need to know when a page has genuine value and how to build scalable local architectures without producing thin or duplicate content.



On-page and copy frameworks

Working directly with our WordPress designer to define what every page type needs before it's built, so SEO is designed into the templates rather than bolted on later. You won't hand-write hundreds of pages — our copy bot handles generation at scale and can be tailored to your suggestions. What you will own is the framework behind it: section mapping, keyword targeting, heading structure, copy briefs, local relevance, entity coverage, FAQs, alt text, anchor text, and quality control on what comes out the other end.



Technical SEO

Crawling and indexing, Search Console, sitemaps, robots.txt, canonicals, redirects, duplicate content, index/noindex decisions, Core Web Vitals, schema, breadcrumbs, crawl depth. You don't need to be the developer, you need to identify issues, explain the fix, and work with our developer to get it implemented correctly.



Existing website migrations

Many clients arrive with an existing site. You'll audit it before anything is replaced and d
 which URLs have real value (rankings, traffic, backlinks), which must be preserved, which get consolidated or removed, and how to sequence the switch. We will not wipe out years of a client's SEO value because a migration was done carelessly.



Google Business Profile and local

This is central to the offer. Setup and optimisation, category selection, services, service areas, photo strategy, review generation and response, NAP consistency, GBP-to-website alignment, Local Pack and Maps rankings, citations, competitor analysis, and resolving GBP issues when they arise. UK knowledge is a real advantage — some categories carry protected-title or accreditation traps. We use or plan to use tools like LeadSnap and are open to whatever you'd recommend.



Off-page and authority

Citations, local and niche-relevant links, competitor backlink analysis, partnerships and outreach where it makes sense. We are not interested in buying hundreds of low-quality links a month. We want a repeatable, commercially sensible authority strategy.



Measurement

Search Console, Analytics, GBP data, rank tracking, Ahrefs or Semrush, Screaming Frog. What's improving, what's declining, what's sitting just outside the top positions, and what's actually generating leads. We don't care about vanity metrics — we care about qualified calls for our clients. We also need to be able to show our clients on a monthly/quarterly basis the results we have generated for them, this task will sit with you.





—-





WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

- Real, demonstrable local SEO experience, ideally with trades and home services — landscapers, roofers, plumbers, electricians, HVAC, cleaning, pest control, drainage and or similar. UK experience is a advantage, but we're open to exceptional candidates anywhere.



- Strong technically, strong on-page, and genuinely hands-on with Google Business Profile — not theoretical.



- Comfortable with WordPress and able to work directly with a designer/developer, setting requirements they implement.



- Able to work at our speed. Sites go live within days of onboarding, so if your process needs three weeks of research per client, this won't be a fit.



- The confidence to tell us we're wrong. We've had people give us confident answers that turned out to be incorrect, and it cost us real time and money. Push back.



- Proactive communication. Daily or near-daily updates, a weekly call, and a heads-up when something slips before it slips — not after.



- Excellent written English. You'll be working directly with me.

Interested in building systems, not just completing tasks.



- Most importantly: think like an owner of the result. If something isn't ranking, we don't want "I completed all my SEO tasks." We want "why isn't it ranking, and what are we doing about it?" This is crucial!





—-





THE OPPORTUNITY



This isn't a freelance gig where we send you random tasks. The right person becomes the SEO Lead behind Local Launchpad.



You'll start by working closely with me and our designer to audit and rebuild our delivery model. From there, the goal is a repeatable SEO system deployable across hundreds of businesses — architecture standards, keyword processes, page mapping, content frameworks, technical checklists, GBP and review systems, migration procedures, QA and reporting.



As we grow, there's scope to lead SEO team members beneath you rather than executing every repetitive task yourself. For the right person this becomes a significant long-term role, with genuine profit share as we scale.



$1000 for the set up of our SEO system with an ongoing monthly retainer and profit share agreed once the set up project has been completed!



A paid test task before either side commits may be required.





—-





HOW TO APPLY



Start your reply with "RANKINGS" so I know you've read the whole post, and open with 2–3 specific results you've achieved for local service businesses — the situation, what you did, and what actually changed. This comes first, before anything else. Applications without it won't be considered.



Then:

1- Your local SEO background — how long, what markets, what types of business



2- Your GBP experience, including tools you use for posting, reviews or rank tracking



3- A client serves 10 locations and offers 8 services. How would you structure that site, and how would you avoid thin or duplicate content? (Be specific — this is the question that matters most to us.)



4- A client comes to us with an existing 20-page site that ranks reasonably well. Walk me through your migration process.



5- Your availability and hours per week



Looking forward to finding the right person and building something great together.

title: Backend Operations Specialist (GoHighLevel, Zapier, Notion) — Systems Build
description:
**Backend Operations Specialist — GoHighLevel, Zapier, Notion,Miro (part-time moving to full-time)**



I run a growth agency. We build and run the entire client acquisition system for insurance advisors and agency owners in Canada — ads, CRM, funnels, automated follow-up, booking, reporting. When a client signs, we have five days to get their whole system built, tested and live. I need one person who can own that build end to end.



Read this part first, because it saves us both time. This is not a general VA role and it is not entry level. If your experience is ecommerce stores, dropshipping, Shopify, posting on social media or general admin, this is not for you and I will not review your application. I want someone who has actually built systems inside a business, and ideally someone who has worked in or around insurance, finance or professional services, because the details matter more in that world and you'll already understand why.



**The stack you'll be living in**



GoHighLevel. Calendly. Zapier. 
. Notion. Slack. Google Drive. Miro. Lovable. Appointwise. Whop. Meta Business Manager (access and tracking setup only — you won't be running campaigns). You don't need to be an expert in every one on day one, but you need to genuinely know most of them and be the kind of person who learns the rest in a weekend rather than asking me for a tutorial.



**What the job actually is**



For each new client, you build the system:



- Spin up the GoHighLevel sub-account, load our snapshot, and check everything came across connected and correct.

- Map the lead form into the pipeline — field mapping, routing, nothing landing in the wrong place.

- Build the booking calendars. Availability, buffers, round robin when there's more than one advisor, and confirmed two-way sync so appointments land in the advisor's own diary and their busy time blocks out. Calendly workflow experience matters here — if you've built booking flows with routing, reminders and reschedule logic, say so.

- Build the confirmation and reminder sequences. Show rate is the number our whole offer is judged on, and these are what protect it.

- Configure the 60-second speed-to-lead response so a new lead gets contacted inside a minute.

- Build the AI booking agent per client — qualification questions, booking logic, tone.

- Load the
 and SMS nurture sequences into the account.

- Set up the reporting dashboard, conversion tracking and internal notification rules.

- QA the whole thing yourself. Submit a real lead through the funnel. Confirm the 60-second response fires, the appointment books into the right calendar, the reminders go out, every form and redirect works. Then send me a screen recording of it working.



Alongside that, you keep the machine itself running: Zapier and 
 scenarios connecting GHL, Slack, Notion and our payment system, the Notion workspace (client portals, task database, filtered views, SOP library), system maps in Miro, and short screen-recorded SOPs so the next person doesn't have to ask.



**How I work, and what I expect**



To be clear about the scope: you are not writing ad copy, making creatives or running ad accounts. Other people handle that side. This role is purely backend — the systems, the automations, the builds, the QA and the admin that sit behind everything. The brief arrives with you clean. Your job is to build it properly and make sure it works.



I give clear tasks. In return I expect them acknowledged quickly during your hours, and I expect to be told before a deadline that something is going to overrun, not after. If a task is going to take three days, tell me on day one. Nothing gets marked done unless you have tested it yourself, on desktop and mobile. When you send your application, title it "Backend Ops — [the tool you are strongest in]" so I know you read this far. I would much rather have someone who asks one good question up front than someone who disappears for two days and comes back having built the wrong thing. Speed matters here because of the five-day clock, but a fast sloppy build costs me a client. I need both.



**What I'm looking for**



- Excellent written and spoken English. Non-negotiable. You'll be writing SOPs, documenting builds and communicating with me every day. If your English is only okay, you will struggle here.

- Real hands-on GoHighLevel. Tell me what you've built in it, not that you're familiar with it.

- Calendly and calendar/booking workflow experience — routing, reminders, sync.

- Genuine automation experience in Zapier — multi-step workflows with error handling and proper filtering, not one-step Zaps. 
 on top of that is a real plus, since some of our scenarios already run there.

- Strong Notion: databases, relations, filtered views, templates.

- Comfortable building in Miro.

- Experience in insurance, finance or corporate professional services is a big advantage and puts you near the top of the pile.

- Self-directed. I'm hiring so there's less on my plate, not more.



**The terms, plainly**



Starts part-time, around 20 hours a week, on my hours (Ireland time). We're launching a new offer right now so the workload builds over the next couple of months, and I expect this to go full-time within roughly two months, replacing my current backend person entirely. Pay starts at $5/hour. I'm not going to dress that up — that's the starting rate while we find out whether you're good. If you are, the hours go up first and the rate goes up after. This role grows into running operations here. If you're looking for short-term work or juggling five other clients, please don't apply.



**How to apply**



1. A Loom video, 2 to 3 minutes, unscripted, walking me through one system or automation you personally built. Show the actual build. What it does, why you built it that way, and what broke while you were building it. No Loom, no review.

2. A short list of what you've built in GoHighLevel.

3. Which of the tools above you've used, and which you haven't. Be honest — I'd rather know.

4. What kind of businesses you've worked with.

5. Your available hours per week now, and whether you can go full-time in two months.



I read every application that follows the instructions. Copy-paste applications and AI-written cover letters are obvious and go straight in the bin.

description:
About Us

We're a U.S.-based B2B appointment-setting company. We help businesses fill their calendars with qualified sales meetings — and we've been doing it for years. We're growing, and we need a sharp, detail-obsessed sales assistant to support one of our senior sales leaders directly.

description:

About Allied Health Media



Allied Health Media (Allied Health Media Limited) is a UK healthcare marketing agency, headquartered in London, founded by Abhay Patel in 2022. It helps private medical consultants grow their practices through AI-driven visibility and patient acquisition — ranking them top-3 on Google Maps and AI search to drive self-pay patient calls. Its core offerings include the 12-month Practice Authority Accelerator program, a website design/build service with ongoing retainer, and the Medical Authority Media Series for video and personal branding, all delivered through an in-house team spanning growth, CS, SEO, production, design, and development.



About the Role



This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who has managed operations before — not simply supported them. You will oversee workflows, team accountability, SOPs, deadlines, reporting and cross-department coordination across teams including Sales, Client Success, SEO, Production and Web Development.



You should be highly organised, proactive and confident working independently. We are looking for someone who can identify problems early, create structure, improve processes and make sure work moves forward without constant follow-up from senior leadership.



This is not an entry-level or junior Operations Manager position.



Key Responsibilities



- Oversee day-to-day operations across multiple departments

- Track projects, priorities, deadlines, owners and blockers

- Improve workflows, handovers and internal processes

- Create, maintain and enforce SOPs

- Manage team accountability, KPIs and performance

- Identify delays, risks and operational problems early

- Coordinate between departments to resolve blockers

- Support workload and capacity planning

- Improve project tracking, dashboards and reporting

- Identify repetitive processes that can be simplified or automated

- Handle operational escalations and resolve issues where possible

- Provide clear updates on performance, risks and priorities to leadership

- Continuously improve systems, efficiency and accountability



Skills Required



- 4+ years of hands-on Operations Management experience

- Experience managing multiple teams, projects and deadlines

- Strong people management and accountability skills

- Proven experience creating and improving SOPs

- Strong project and workflow management skills

- Experience with KPIs, dashboards and operational reporting

- Excellent problem-solving and decision-making ability

- Strong written and verbal English communication

- Highly organised, proactive and detail-oriented

- Comfortable working independently and taking ownership

- Able to manage remote and distributed teams

- Confident handling underperformance and difficult conversations

- Able to identify inefficiencies and implement practical solutions



Compensation



We offer a competitive, performance-based package tailored to your experience and track record, with room to grow as you take on more client responsibility. This is a long-term opportunity with a stable, growing agency — not a short-term contract — and we reward accuracy, reliability, and great work with real career progression.



Why Join Us?



Work across a real portfolio of client websites, including meaningful healthcare projects where your work genuinely matters.

Join a fast-growing team where your audits and recommendations directly shape client results.

Flexible, remote-friendly setup with a supportive, collaborative team culture.

Room to grow into more senior SEO or strategy roles as the company scales.

Exposure to a variety of tools, platforms, and industries — never the same day twice.

A team that values professional judgement, accuracy, and follow-through over vanity metrics.



Ready to Join a Fast-Growing Team?

title: Assitant Restaurant Manager
description:
Happyfoods Group of Restaurants is the visionary team behind some of the Philippines' most celebrated Korean dining concepts. As the Master Franchisee of the award-winning Sariwon Korean Barbecue—a mainstay in Philippine Tatler Dining's Best Restaurants Guide since 2013—we have successfully expanded our portfolio with the modern Soban K-Town Grill and the unlimited concept Sibyullee.



Continuing our growth in 2025, we introduced Samsam Chikin Korean Café + Kitchen at Greenbelt 3 and the premium grilling experience Sogeum by Soban at Opus Mall, Bridgetowne.



We are currently looking for a dynamic Assistant Restaurant Manager to lead our high-performing team and uphold our mission of providing exceptional dining experiences.



Job Overview



The Assistant Restaurant Manager is the Restaurant Manager's vital partner in delivering an exceptional and memorable dining experience. You will serve as a leader on the floor, performing Shift Manager functions while supervising daily operations to maintain an inviting restaurant environment.



Track 1: Assistant Restaurant Manager 1 (Kitchen Operations)



Focus: Ensures an effective, efficient, safe, and sanitary Kitchen operation at all times.



Training: Responsible for the orientation, training, and certification of kitchen staff to meet high skill and knowledge standards.



Quality Control: Guarantees food quality and safety standards are strictly followed.



Track 2: Assistant Restaurant Manager 2 (Dining Operations)



Focus: Ensures effective, efficient, safe, and sanitary Dining/Front-of-House operations.



Training: Orients, trains, and certifies dining staff to provide world-class service.



Customer Experience: Manages the "inviting and welcoming" atmosphere of the restaurant floor.



Applicants must be flexible to work across both Kitchen Operations and Dining Operations tracks as required by business needs.



Job Qualifications



Education: Bachelor's/College Degree in Hospitality/Tourism/Hotel Management, Food & Beverage Services Management, Business Administration, Food Technology, Nutrition, or equivalent.



Experience: At least 3 years of working experience in a related field (Assistant Manager/Manager) specializing in Food/Beverage/Restaurant Service.



Skills: Strong leadership, multitasking, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.



Possible Deployment Locations



Pasig: Ayala Malls The 30th



BGC



QC: SM North Edsa



Manila: Robinsons Manila



Parañaque: Ayala Malls Manila Bay



Successful candidates must accept assignment to any of the deployment locations based on operational requirements.
